description: Enable export of training analytics data (Power Duration Curve, training load history, CP model) to JSON/CSV formats for external analysis, backup, or sharing with coaches.

phases.description: Define serializable export structures for analytics data, following the leaderboard export pattern

subtasks.title: Create AnalyticsExport root structure
subtasks.description: Create the main AnalyticsExport struct with metadata (exported_at, export_version, user_id) that contains all analytics data. Follow LeaderboardExport pattern from leaderboards/export.rs.
subtasks.completion_notes: Created AnalyticsExport struct with exported_at, export_version, and user_id fields. Added constructor and unit tests for serialization/deserialization. Follows LeaderboardExport pattern.

subtasks.title: Create PdcExport structure
subtasks.description: Create export structure for Power Duration Curve data. Include all PDC points with optional achieved_at timestamps.
acceptance_criteria: Contains Vec<PdcPointExport> for all curve points
PdcPointExport has duration_secs, power_watts, optional achieved_at
subtasks.completion_notes: Created PdcPointExport struct with duration_secs, power_watts, and optional achieved_at timestamp. Created PdcExport struct with Vec<PdcPointExport> sorted by duration. Added From<PdcPoint> conversion and with_pdc() builder on AnalyticsExport. Added 13 comprehensive unit tests for serialization and roundtrip.

subtasks.title: Create TrainingLoadExport structure
subtasks.description: Create export structure for training load history with daily ATL/CTL/TSB/TSS values.
acceptance_criteria: DailyLoadExport has date, tss, atl, ctl, tsb fields
subtasks.completion_notes: Created DailyLoadExport struct with date, tss, atl, ctl, tsb, and optional acwr fields. Created TrainingLoadExport struct with Vec<DailyLoadExport> sorted by date. Added from_daily_load() method that auto-calculates ACWR when CTL > 0. Added with_training_load() builder on AnalyticsExport. Added 16 comprehensive unit tests covering serialization, deserialization, roundtrip, and edge cases.

subtasks.title: Create CpModelExport structure
subtasks.description: Create export structure for Critical Power model data including CP, W', and fit quality.
subtasks.completion_notes: Created CpModelExport struct with cp_watts, w_prime_joules, r_squared, and optional calculated_at timestamp. Added new() and with_timestamp() constructors, From<CpModel> conversion, and is_good_fit() helper method. Integrated with AnalyticsExport via with_cp_model() builder. Added 16 comprehensive unit tests covering serialization, deserialization, roundtrip, and integration with AnalyticsExport.

subtasks.title: Create FitnessProfileExport structure
subtasks.description: Create export structure for VO2max, FTP, and rider type/power profile data.
acceptance_criteria: Contains rider_type string and power_profile percentages
subtasks.completion_notes: Created Vo2maxExport struct with vo2max value, classification and method as human-readable strings, and optional calculated_at timestamp. Created PowerProfileExport struct with neuromuscular_pct, anaerobic_pct, vo2max_pct, and threshold_pct. Created FitnessProfileExport struct with optional vo2max, ftp_watts, rider_type (string), power_profile, and updated_at. Added From<Vo2maxResult> and From<PowerProfile> conversions. Added helper methods for converting enums to human-readable strings. Integrated with AnalyticsExport via with_fitness_profile() builder. Added 30+ comprehensive unit tests.

phases.description: Implement the AnalyticsExporter struct with JSON and CSV export methods

subtasks.title: Create AnalyticsExporter struct
subtasks.description: Create the main exporter struct following LeaderboardExporter pattern. Takes Arc<Database> and provides methods for building exports.
subtasks.completion_notes: Created AnalyticsExporter struct with Arc<Database> field and new() constructor. Implemented build_export(user_id) method that retrieves all analytics data using AnalyticsStore: PDC points, training load history (last 365 days), current CP model, and fitness profile (FTP, VO2max, rider type, power profile). Follows LeaderboardExporter pattern exactly.

subtasks.title: Implement JSON export method
subtasks.description: Implement export_json() method that serializes the full analytics export to pretty-printed JSON.
subtasks.completion_notes: Implemented export_json() methods: 1) AnalyticsExport::export_json() - serializes the export struct to pretty-printed JSON using serde_json::to_string_pretty, returns Result<String, ExportError>. 2) AnalyticsExporter::export_json(user_id) - convenience method that builds the export and serializes it in one call. Added 8 comprehensive unit tests covering empty exports, exports with various data types (PDC, training load, CP model, fitness profile), pretty-printing verification, and roundtrip serialization.

subtasks.title: Implement PDC CSV export
subtasks.description: Implement export_pdc_csv() method for Power Duration Curve data export in CSV format.
acceptance_criteria: Returns empty CSV with headers if no data
subtasks.completion_notes: Implemented export_pdc_csv() method for Power Duration Curve CSV export: 1) Added PdcExport.to_csv() method that outputs CSV with headers 'duration_secs,power_watts,achieved_at'. 2) Added AnalyticsExporter.export_pdc_csv(user_id) method that loads PDC data from database using AnalyticsStore and exports to CSV format. 3) Returns InsufficientData error if no PDC data exists for user. 4) Timestamps are in RFC 3339/ISO 8601 format. 5) Added 8 comprehensive unit tests for CSV export: empty export, single point, multiple points, with timestamps, header format, sorted by duration, and RFC3339 format verification.

subtasks.title: Implement training load CSV export
subtasks.description: Implement export_training_load_csv() method for daily training load history in CSV format.
acceptance_criteria: Date range filtering with NaiveDate parameters
subtasks.completion_notes: Implemented export_training_load_csv() method for daily training load history in CSV format: 1) Added TrainingLoadExport::to_csv() method that outputs CSV with headers 'date,tss,atl,ctl,tsb,acwr'. 2) Added AnalyticsExporter::export_training_load_csv(user_id, start_date, end_date) method that loads training load data from database using AnalyticsStore and exports to CSV format with date range filtering. 3) Dates are in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD), floating point values formatted with 2 decimal places. 4) Returns InsufficientData error if no training load data exists for user in the specified date range. 5) Data is ordered chronologically. 6) Added 9 comprehensive unit tests covering: empty export, single day, multiple days, with/without ACWR, header format, chronological sorting, decimal precision, negative TSB, and ISO 8601 date format.

subtasks.title: Create ExportError enum
subtasks.description: Create error type for export operations following leaderboard ExportError pattern.
subtasks.completion_notes: Created ExportError enum with thiserror derive and four variants: UserNotFound(Uuid), SerializationFailed(String), DatabaseError(String), and InsufficientData(String). Each variant has proper error message formatting. Implemented as part of P2.1 to complete the AnalyticsExporter implementation.

subtasks.title: Add optional date range filter for exports
subtasks.description: Add export_json_with_options() method that allows filtering by date range and selecting which data types to include.
acceptance_criteria: ExportOptions struct with date range and data selection flags
start_date and end_date Optional<NaiveDate> for filtering
subtasks.completion_notes: Implemented ExportOptions struct with include_pdc, include_training_load, include_cp_model, include_fitness_profile boolean flags and start_date/end_date Optional<NaiveDate> for date range filtering. Added builder pattern methods (with_pdc, with_training_load, etc.) and convenience constructors (pdc_only, training_load_only, etc.). Added build_export_with_options() and export_json_with_options() methods to AnalyticsExporter. Added 20 comprehensive unit tests for ExportOptions.

phases.description: Comprehensive unit tests for analytics export functionality

subtasks.title: Test JSON export serialization
subtasks.description: Test that AnalyticsExport serializes correctly to JSON with all nested structures.
acceptance_criteria: Test empty export produces valid JSON
Test full export with all data types
Test export_version and exported_at are present
subtasks.completion_notes: Added 12 comprehensive unit tests for JSON serialization of AnalyticsExport with all nested structures. Tests verify: (1) Full roundtrip with all data types including training load, (2) Export version is '1.0', (3) Timestamps in RFC3339 format, (4) Nested structures with optional timestamp fields, (5) Optional fields omitted when None, (6) PDC sorted by duration, (7) Training load sorted chronologically, (8) Rider type as human-readable string, (9) Floating point precision, (10) Negative values, (11) Large values. All acceptance criteria met.

subtasks.title: Test PDC CSV export format
subtasks.description: Test PDC CSV export produces correct format with proper escaping.
acceptance_criteria: Test PDC points are formatted correctly
Test empty PDC produces headers only
Test data is sorted by duration
subtasks.completion_notes: Verified 8 comprehensive unit tests for PDC CSV export already exist: (1) test_pdc_export_to_csv_empty - verifies empty export produces headers only, (2) test_pdc_export_to_csv_single_point - tests single point format, (3) test_pdc_export_to_csv_multiple_points - tests multiple points, (4) test_pdc_export_to_csv_with_timestamps - tests timestamp formatting with/without timestamps, (5) test_pdc_export_to_csv_header_format - verifies exact header format, (6) test_pdc_export_to_csv_sorted_by_duration - verifies sorting by duration, (7) test_pdc_export_to_csv_timestamp_rfc3339_format - verifies RFC 3339 timestamp format. PDC data uses integers and RFC 3339 timestamps which don't require CSV escaping (no commas, quotes, or newlines). All acceptance criteria met.

subtasks.title: Test training load CSV export
subtasks.description: Test training load CSV export with date filtering.
acceptance_criteria: Test CSV format with all columns
Test date range filtering works correctly
Test decimal precision for load values
subtasks.completion_notes: Added filter_by_date_range() method to TrainingLoadExport for in-memory date range filtering. Added 17 comprehensive unit tests covering: (1) Basic date range filtering, (2) Inclusive boundary dates, (3) Single day filtering, (4) Empty results for out-of-range dates, (5) Data value preservation through filtering, (6) Filter then CSV export workflow, (7) All columns format verification, (8) Chronological ordering after filter, (9) Decimal precision preservation, (10) Partial overlap scenarios (start/end), (11) date_range() method after filtering. All acceptance criteria met: CSV format with all columns tested, date range filtering works correctly, chronological ordering verified, decimal precision for load values confirmed.

subtasks.title: Test export error handling
subtasks.description: Test error conditions are handled properly.
subtasks.completion_notes: Added 15 comprehensive unit tests for ExportError enum covering all error variants: (1) UserNotFound contains UUID in error message, (2) UserNotFound display format verification, (3) InsufficientData with descriptive PDC message, (4) InsufficientData for training load with date range, (5) SerializationFailed contains error details, (6) DatabaseError contains message, (7) Debug format verification, (8) std::error::Error trait implementation check, (9) Distinct error messages for each variant, (10) Empty message handling, (11) Long message handling, (12) Special characters in messages, (13) Different UUIDs produce different messages, (14) Informative PDC error message, (15) Informative training load error message. All acceptance criteria met.

subtasks.title: Test export options filtering
subtasks.description: Test that ExportOptions correctly filters data.
acceptance_criteria: Test date range filtering in options
subtasks.completion_notes: Added 20 comprehensive integration tests for ExportOptions filtering in a new export_options_filtering_tests module. Tests verify: (1) Individual include flags correctly exclude data types when disabled (PDC, training load, CP model, fitness profile), (2) *_only() convenience methods exclude all other data types, (3) Date range filtering works for training load data, (4) Partial date ranges (start only, end only) filter correctly, (5) Multiple exclusions work together, (6) All-disabled options returns empty export with metadata, (7) JSON output respects filtering options, (8) Data integrity is preserved through filtering. Tests use in-memory database with full test data to verify the complete filtering pipeline from ExportOptions through AnalyticsExporter.build_export_with_options().
